## Environment

## Reproduction

Provide minimal configuration, exact tool names, steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
State whether the failure requires resume, compaction, or plugin reload.

## Evidence

Include the error code and redacted logs. Never include credentials or private tool arguments.
Report exploitable issues through the security policy instead of this public template.
